text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder appears more upbeat than before as she exits the waiting room, fully prepared to race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to walk her own path, Grass Wonder heads for the track, where her formidable opponent Special Week awaits.
